html:
Enjoy a premium island-hopping experience in Nha Trang with Vietlook Travel’s 3 Island VIP Tour. This tour combines crystal-clear beaches, exciting sea activities, local island culture, and a luxurious mud bath & hydrotherapy experience at Hon Tam Island. It is the perfect choice for travelers who want relaxation, comfort, and unforgettable moments in Nha Trang Bay.

TOUR ITINERARY

08:00 – 08:30
Car and professional English-speaking tour guide pick you up at the meeting point.

08:45
Board a speed canoe and begin the VIP island tour.

SAN HO BAY / BAI TRANH BEACH

09:00
Arrive at San Ho Bay or Bai Tranh Beach.

Free time to swim, relax, and enjoy the sea. Complimentary beach chairs are provided.

Optional water activities are available at your own expense, such as jet ski, parasailing, scuba diving, sea walking, banana boat, and more.

FISHING VILLAGE

11:00
Visit a traditional fishing village.

Have lunch at a local restaurant on the island, where guests can enjoy fresh seafood and local specialties (own expense).

After lunch, relax and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of island life.

HON TAM ISLAND

12:30
Arrive at Hon Tam Island and enjoy a premium relaxation experience.

Guests can use the mud bath service package and full-body hydrotherapy massage system, including free use of towels and bathing suits.

Free time to take photos, swim, and relax at the 2,400 m² swimming pool with a stunning panoramic view of Nha Trang Bay.

15:30 – 16:00
Return to the mainland by canoe. End of the tour.

TOUR PRICE

Price per person (pax): USD 28

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Hotel pick-up by car

  • Speed canoe transportation

  • Lunch on the island

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • Entrance tickets

  • Bottled water

  • Beach chairs and resting huts

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • VAT

  • Personal expenses

  • Optional water activities outside the program

CHILDREN POLICY

  • Children under 1 meter: Free of charge

  • From 1m to 1.29m: 70% of adult price

  • From 1.29m and above: Adult price applies
outline: Day 1: DISCOVER NHA TRANG BEACH 3 ISLAND VIP TOUR
